ms.report:
Take 2. 
The Jormungandr Explorer section has been added to the sidebar menu. Here are links to all publicly accessible links
・Voting histories - Note that this data is being brought over from the Jormungandr blockchain raw… Columns like the Time field are being shown raw as is on jormangandre. We will revisit this in the future to add some interpretations to improve the UX in a future update. For the scope of this milestone, hope just showing the data will suffice. The current value looks like star dates to us 🤷

・Catalyst Transaction records - these records are said to be privacy preserving because, while you can see that this stake address or catalyst id voted for nth number of things, you are still not able to see how they voted nor what specific things they voted for.

・Single transaction view

For logged in users, we’ve included views for both votes and transactions in the dashboard that shows you only the votes and transactions associated with wallets you’ve linked to your account. This is well explained in the YouTube video, but for testing, we created a testing account for you to see your private transaction voting histories and votes.
Test account credentials:
・Email: reviewer@reviewer.io
・Password: Reviewer1

We’ve added a new Proposal Comparison feature accessible from the Proposals page link on the sidebar navigation. Per your feedback we’ve added a horizontal scrollbar. The popup is so that comparison can be brought up from any page instantly without having to call the server (the data is stored directly in your browser and should work without even an internet connection). We will work a toggle for the size of the popup so folks that want full screen and toggle to a full screen popup. This work has been put into our backlog as a nice have… coming soooon!
